info.title: SaaS House Rental Web MVP API
info.description: Interactive contract for Super Admin, landlord/staff and renter Web MVP flows. Existing route URLs are kept stable.

bearerAuth.description: Access token returned by auth login/session APIs

details.description: Optional structured validation or domain error details

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the token is invalid

Forbidden.description: The current principal is not allowed to perform this operation

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in the caller scope

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current resource state

RateLimited.description: The configured request limit has been exceeded
